subject: Physics
subtopic: Quantitative friction, common acceleration and ideal-string constraint
axis_note: Owner-approved ExamSIDE preparation-demand matrix implementing the first production slice from the merged NLM reconnaissance. Momentum-rate and non-ideal pulley depth are deliberately separate.

must_contain: A normal reaction obtained from the actual perpendicular force equation.
A consistency check against the static limit or sliding model.

controlled_variation.vary: applied tangential force below the static limit
controlled_variation.notice: actual static friction changes while mu_sN remains only the ceiling
the friction limit changes because N changes

must_contain: At least two body-specific Newton-II equations.
An explicit physical reason for the common acceleration component.
No cross-body cancellation of third-law forces inside an individual FBD equation.

controlled_variation.notice: the common acceleration can stay shared while each body's net force requirement changes

controlled_variation.vary: the contact state from maintained together-motion to slip/separation
controlled_variation.notice: the common-acceleration constraint must be removed when the physical constraint fails

must_contain: Massless inextensible string and smooth fixed pulley declared.
One tension magnitude used on separate body FBDs.
A fixed-length equation that produces the signed endpoint acceleration relation.

controlled_variation.notice: T and acceleration values change while the one-string constraint remains

controlled_variation.vary: the pulley/model away from the ideal fixed case
controlled_variation.notice: equal tension or one-to-one acceleration may no longer be justified

family.invariant_demand: Declare the contact/connection state first, keep body-specific force ownership, impose only physically justified kinematic constraints, and verify the solved forces/accelerations against those assumptions.
family.difficult_move: Knowing which equality is conditional: static friction is bounded before limiting, common acceleration requires together-motion, and equal tension/fixed-pulley acceleration require the declared ideal string model.
family.independent_check: Static friction satisfies its bound; every body equation closes; shared acceleration matches the physical constraint; ideal-string endpoint accelerations satisfy fixed length.

support_ladder.handed_over: Contact state, body boundaries and connection assumptions are supplied.
Bodies and geometry are supplied; learner chooses state/constraint relations.
Only the physical setup and requested force/acceleration are supplied.

transfer.changed_demand: A friction coefficient is given but the learner must decide whether the contact is below limit, limiting or sliding.
Two or more bodies remain together and a contact force or common acceleration is requested.
transfer.information_not_handed_over: the separate body equations and justified common-acceleration constraint

transfer.changed_demand: A string/pulley story must be converted into separate FBD equations plus a fixed-length kinematic constraint.
transfer.information_not_handed_over: which equalities follow from the ideal string/pulley assumptions
